## KaliScriber 0.3.5

Install the `arm64-v8a` APK on most phones (`universal` if unsure). It updates over earlier builds and keeps your meetings and settings.

### Speaker detection fixes
- **Keeps running in the background.** Re-detecting speakers, separating them with AI, and regenerating summaries now run under a "Processing meeting" notification with the phone kept awake. They finish even if you leave the meeting, switch apps or lock the phone. Before, Android could pause them, and leaving the screen could cancel them.
- **More accurate speaker counts.** On-device detection tended to split one person into several. Speakers are now matched by voice across the whole meeting, so the count comes out closer to the real number. In a four-person test recording, the same person was matched across blocks 98% of the time.
- **Smaller blocks for long meetings.** Recordings are processed in 10-minute blocks, so progress moves sooner and memory use is lower.
- **No silent switch to AI.** If on-device detection fails, the app now shows why instead of quietly falling back to the much slower AI separation. You can still choose **Re-detect speakers with AI** from the menu.
- **AI separation can't get stuck.** It shows "part 2 of 12" progress. Each part has a reply-length cap and a 5-minute limit, so one slow reply can't hold up the whole meeting.
